purpose: ImpactV2Plus训练新增10000轮的阶段对照；非最终泛化结论

settings.knockdown: 持续躯干接地0.15秒，或高度低于0.45米/倾斜超过80度持续0.30秒
settings.recovery: 受击后2.5秒内物理稳定并回到拳架；超时不等于倒地，评估中不会因此提前结束
limits: 仅平地、健康头部；不含完整地形/头故障/实机测试
恢复率按策略各自触发并完成观察的失衡事件统计，事件分母不相同
成功恢复耗时仅统计成功事件
踝8Hz指标为一阶高通残差RMS，非理想频带能量

cases.label: plus_continue_164500

physical_diagnostics.highpass_filter: first-order 8Hz cutoff at physical timestep; RMS residual, not a brick-wall spectrum

measurement_notes: Exactly one fixed-command trial per environment; no replacement trials after termination.
All physical metrics, including RMSE, stop at first termination and include its pre-reset frame.
Aggregates weight individual valid simulation samples; xy RMSE is the planar error norm.
Velocity is in the 37-degree tactical yaw frame; angular rate is root body-z rad/s.
Recovery_v1 uses true knockdown persistence and separate recovery/guard timing; support and foot-side contacts are events.
Impact plan is pre-generated and hashed before simulation so policy termination cannot alter later load parameters.
Recovery mean counts completed recoveries only; expired windows and falls are reported separately.
Extra displacement is the runtime's maximum command-relative 2-second measurement deviation.

interpretation.verified: 同一初始物理状态与各模式同一击打计划哈希；15组测试完成
interpretation.finding: Plus在本次短测中限时稳住并回拳架的比例提高，但强击倒地次数没有下降；无击打平地行走未观察到倒地，踝高频指标仅小幅降低
interpretation.recommendation: 两路继续训练并观察；下一次用相同评估标准复测，暂不能认定Plus全面优于V2

cleanup.host_109: 本次临时模型、评估日志、Kit日志和中断测试的USD缓存已清理；原有候选模型保留
